main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise. A spacious 2,053m oval featuring sweeping cambered turns and the longest home straight in South Australia (453 metres). The broad sweeps and long run-in make this one of the fairest tracks in Australia, heavily favoring strong-finishing stalkers ('P') and deep closers ('Swoopers'). One-dimensional front-runners often tire over the grueling 453m stretch.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1000m and 1050m sprint chute starts, middle-to-outside draws (4-8) fare very well as jockeys have plenty of straight running room before entering the cambered turn. In 1400m and 1600m chute starts, inside-to-middle barriers (2-6) are preferred to save ground along the back straight.

handicapping_angles.longest_sa_straight_swooper_upgrade: With a 453m home straight, waiting until the final furlong to make a challenge is completely viable. Aggressively upgrade horses with proven L400m/L200m closing speed ratings ('S' / 'Swoopers') and downgrade weak leaders that lack genuine distance stamina.
handicapping_angles.adelaide_metro_shipper_class_spike: Top Adelaide metropolitan stables (Jolly, Stokes, Clarken/O'Shea, Hickmott) regularly target Balaklava for high-value maidens and benchmark handicaps. Heavily upgrade horses dropping out of Saturday Morphettville or Parks company into local provincial classes.
handicapping_angles.balaklava_cup_interstate_raid: During the September Balaklava Cup meeting, high-class Victorian pattern runners invade SA. Local provincial form lines must be heavily downgraded against Tier 1 Melbourne metropolitan shippers.
handicapping_angles.long_1050m_chute_fairness: Do not automatically toss wide-drawn sprinters in 1000m or 1050m events. The long chute gives jockeys ample time to find cover or build rhythm before hitting the sweeping home turn.
handicapping_angles.sa_benchmark_weight_penalty: In SA Provincial Benchmark races (BM54-BM72), top-weight runners carrying 59.5kg+ face a strict penalty over the 453m straight (1kg = ~1 length). In Listed feature events (Balaklava Cup), ignore minor weight spreads and prioritize peak class and rated form.
